name: confluence-render
description: Publish Markdown and HTML files to Confluence Cloud as real pages, shown in full by the open-source Markdown & HTML file macro.

email.title: Atlassian email
email.description: The email you log in to Confluence with

api_token.title: Atlassian API token
api_token.description: Make one at id.atlassian.com/manage-profile/security/api-tokens. Use a scoped token with only the scopes in the README. Stored in your system keychain.

macro_key.title: Macro key
macro_key.description: Leave as is unless you deployed your own copy of the Confluence app. Then open its macro settings in Confluence and copy 'Key for the Claude plugin'.
